column3: With respect to the Troy Towne Center Mortgage Loan (1.3%), one of the three parcels comprising the Mortgaged Property benefits from a ten-year tax exemption on the increase in the assessed value of the land, improvements, buildings, fixtures, and structures that existed as of January 2011. The exemption does not apply to any new improvements, buildings, fixtures and structures built after January 2011. The tax exemption was granted as a result of the environmental remediation work to address former dry-cleaning operations at the Mortgaged Property. See “—Environmental Considerations” above. The exemption began in the 2021 tax year and expires in 2031. The related lender underwrote real estate taxes based on the parcel’s assessed value remaining at $2,491,690 through the 2030 tax year. Thereafter, the exemption will no longer apply and taxes will increase on this parcel specifically and the Mortgaged Property generally.
